release_notes:
• Initial public release of Animarvle
• Pure OLED Black (#000000) Obsidian Glass user interface
• AniList anime rails and TMDB movies & TV shows catalog
• AndroidX Media3 / ExoPlayer adaptive HLS streaming engine
• Hardwired edge stream resolver for sub-second startup
• Google Drive AppData cloud synchronization for My List watchlist
• Smart auto-rotate fullscreen player expansion
• Multi-architecture packaging (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, universal)
